title.narrative: Activity under preparation EU Support to the aviation sector in Africa

description.narrative: The Action consists of technical cooperation in the field of civil aviation, with the objective of developing a safe and sustainable aviation environment on the African continent. The action aims at capacity building for aviation safety, environmental protection and climate action, the introduction of new sustainable technologies and aviation related regulatory infrastructure. Furthermore, it will support the development of the Single African Air Transport Market (SAATM), a process initiated by the African Union and driven by the African Civil Aviation Commission (AFCAC) to develop a single aviation market of intra-African air traffic.The Action will support the following aspects: i) advocate the development of a safe, sustainable and integrated aviation market throughout the continent; ii) improve the regulatory environment; iii) improving capacity to ensure safe and sustainable aviation; and iv) facilitating market access for EU industry by enabling exchange with aviation authorities and African aviation communities.This Action fully contributes to the EU Global Gateway strategy in supporting its pledge to deliver smart and sustainable connectivity, fostering regional and continental integration, improving security and safety of mobility, facilitating trade, while also fostering convergence with European or international technical and environmental standards.
